column1: # Project Voyager partition table (4 MB flash).
# Bluetooth Classic serial makes the firmware about 1.86 MB
# 1.25 MB app slots of the Arduino default table. This table keeps OTA (two app
# slots) by shrinking the filesystem to 320 KB; the web UI in data/ is about 130 KB.
# A partition table cannot be changed over OTA: a board that was flashed with the
# old layout must be flashed once over USB (web flasher) to get this one.
